findings.excerpt: The title renders ‘S3’ as plain text rather than a subscripted group symbol.

findings.excerpt: The title renders ‘S4’ as plain text rather than a subscripted group symbol.
findings.symptom: Raw group notation in the display title.
findings.suggested_repair: Typeset the group symbol as math, for example $S_4$.

findings.excerpt: The title renders W^I with a literal caret instead of a superscript.
findings.symptom: Raw exponent notation in the display title.
findings.suggested_repair: Typeset the parabolic quotient as math, for example $W^I$.

findings.excerpt: The uppercase technique banner displays the source delimiters and formula literally: ‘USE $C=ST$ AND THE EXACT ORDER $M$…’.
findings.symptom: Math inside the CSS uppercase technique banner is not passed through the math renderer.
findings.suggested_repair: Keep the banner's wording as plain text or render its math spans before applying uppercase styling.

findings.excerpt: The uppercase technique banner shows ‘$ST$’ literally in ‘USING THE EXACT ORDER OF $ST$’.
findings.symptom: Math inside the CSS uppercase technique banner is not passed through the math renderer.
findings.suggested_repair: Keep the banner's wording as plain text or render its math spans before applying uppercase styling.

findings.excerpt: The uppercase technique banner displays ‘$S_1S_2S_3$’ literally.

diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The example explicitly distinguishes the full Davis 2-cell as a regular hexagon, the six typed boundary edges, and the square chamber with a diagonal. A simple schematic would make the relationship between the 6-cycle boundary and the two-triangle chamber visible.
diagram_candidates.content: Draw a hexagon with alternating s/t edge labels, mark six vertices and the 2-cell; separately indicate the chamber square with its diagonal and its two triangles, using labels consistent with K=|S|.
diagram_candidates.checks: Keep the six boundary vertices and edges distinct from the single 2-cell; ensure edge labels alternate s,t; show the chamber diagonal as the shared edge of the two triangular chains; do not imply six 2-cells.

diagram_candidates.why_warranted: The example's claims depend on exact edge labels and path/star shapes: H3 and H4 positive-definite cases are contrasted with two overlong paths and a degree-three star witness.
diagram_candidates.content: Draw labeled path H3 (3,5), path H4 (3,3,5), excluded paths (3,5,3) and (3,3,5,3), and the 3,3,5 star; distinguish included H3/H4 types from excluded diagrams.
diagram_candidates.checks: Use the source's path order and edge labels exactly; mark the star's three incident labels as 3,3,5; do not conflate a Coxeter diagram edge label with a matrix entry; optionally annotate the stated determinants/witness only if verified.

visual_summary.other_visual_checks: No authored TikZ/diagram environment was present in the 35 assigned item bodies. Checked the S3 element/sign table, Cambrian projection/fiber tables and weak-order operation tables, A2 typed boundary/cell claims, H3/H4 path-label and determinant claims, and the visible formulas in the matrix examples; no map, orientation, index, or sign error was confirmed.

scope: Local revision-2 ItemBody previews only. No production HTTP(S) or live site was accessed. Assignment snapshots, HTML, source and hashes were compared from disk; visual findings are based on separately opened original-resolution PNG tiles. CSS uppercase technique banners and block-line wikilinks are expected renderer conventions; only raw math within banners/titles and observed clipping are reported.
